checks.description: artifact-manifest.json is in a schema this tool implements, names an integrity algorithm it can reproduce, lists only valid member paths and SHA-256 digests, and declares every descriptive record it leaves outside the digest together with a reason
SHA-256 over the canonicalised members of package/ recomputed from disk
sha256(package/contract/contract-surface.json) equals the pinned contract digest, so any third-party tool can reproduce contract_digest
compiler verify_release_identity over the re-compiled shipped manifest (module id, module version, manifest schema, contract digest, package digest, migration namespace)

artifact-manifest.json, release.json, the shipped module.manifest.json and the shipped migration mapping agree on module_id, module_version, manifest schema, contract digest, package digest and migration namespace

release-bundle.json's crate_versions matches the [package] name and version of every Cargo.toml in the payload: a missing, extra, duplicated or renamed crate, or a version that differs from the packed manifest, is refused
every pinned migration file is re-read from its formal catalog and must match that catalog's MANIFEST.sha256 and its bytes on disk

release.json's source_revision names a commit object in this repository, resolved by git rather than by reading .git/HEAD, refs and packed-refs by hand, so a detached HEAD, a linked worktree and a shallow clone all mean the same commit here that git means

every payload member that copies a repository file verbatim, and every file that only feeds a derived record (the crate manifests before packing, the workspace manifest, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, the release spec and the migration catalog files), equals the blob stored at that path in the pinned commit; a modified-but-uncommitted input therefore cannot produce a candidate, and cannot leave an older candidate verifying
checks.detail: 19 payload member(s) and 9 feeding file(s) compared with commit '69d9a6b01184db7d9f3d4aa3b688fb569387b2fc'; the derived members (module.manifest.json, contract-surface.json, migration-mapping.json and the packed Cargo.toml files) are re-derived by the compile, digest and catalog checks above from exactly these inputs
